description: This file contains the implementation of the Sizzle CSS Selector Engine, version 1.10.17-pre. It defines functions for selecting DOM elements based on CSS selectors, supports various filtering and matching mechanisms, caches, and utility functions. It is a standalone JavaScript library used within a web project for advanced DOM querying.

methods.name: Sizzle
methods.description: Main selector function for matching elements based on CSS selector string within a context, returning an array of matched elements.

methods.name: createCache
methods.description: Creates a cache object to store selector results with limited size for performance optimization.

methods.name: markFunction
methods.description: Marks functions with a special expando property for special handling within Sizzle.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Tests support for certain DOM features by executing a function and catching exceptions.

methods.name: addHandle
methods.description: Adds attribute handlers for specified attributes.

methods.name: siblingCheck
methods.description: Checks document order of two sibling elements.

methods.name: createInputPseudo
methods.description: Creates pseudo-class functions for input types.

methods.name: createButtonPseudo
methods.description: Creates pseudo-class functions for button types.

methods.name: createPositionalPseudo
methods.description: Creates pseudo-class functions for positional selectors like :nth.

methods.name: testContext
methods.description: Verifies whether a given context element is suitable for Sizzle queries.

methods.name: setDocument
methods.description: Initializes document-specific variables and support tests for the current document.

methods.name: support
methods.description: Object holding feature support detections used internally.

methods.name: matchExpr
methods.description: Object holding regular expressions for matching different CSS selector components.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes CSS selector strings into structured tokens for parsing.

methods.name: toSelector
methods.description: Converts tokens back into a CSS selector string.

methods.name: addCombinator
methods.description: Wraps a matcher with a combinator (e.g., descendant, child, sibling).

methods.name: elementMatcher
methods.description: Combines multiple matchers into a single matcher that returns true if all match.

methods.name: condense
methods.description: Filters an array of unmatched elements based on a filter function.

methods.name: setMatcher
methods.description: Wraps match functions with additional pre/post filtering and context logic.

methods.name: matcherFromTokens
methods.description: Builds a matcher function from a list of tokens.

methods.name: matcherFromGroupMatchers
methods.description: Combines element and set matchers into a single matching function.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a CSS selector string into a reusable matcher function.

methods.name: multipleContexts
methods.description: Executes a selector against multiple context nodes.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Executes a compiled selector against a context to find matching elements.
